# SRV Studio

> A studio that takes a brand from positioning through to production, and a product from idea through to release. One team for the whole chain.

SRV Studio is a creative and technology agency founded in September 2025, based in Istanbul, Türkiye and working with brands and institutions in Türkiye, Europe and Australia. Brand work, the software behind it and the growth that follows are run by the same team, which is why the campaign, the product and the reporting do not drift apart.

Contact: hi@srv.studio · WhatsApp +90 534 641 55 99
Profiles: [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/srvstudio/) · [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/studiosrv/) · [Behance](https://www.behance.net/srvstudio)

## What we do

- Brand and identity: positioning, naming, identity systems, packaging and print
- Content and social: editorial direction, production, channel management
- Software and platforms: websites, products and internal tools
- Growth and performance: paid media, measurement, lifecycle
- AI and automation: assistants trained on a client's own material, document and data pipelines, workflow automation

## Services

Each page lists what is delivered, who it was delivered for, the results where they have been measured, and a short FAQ.

- [Brand and Identity](https://srv.studio/services/brand-and-identity): positioning, identity systems, packaging and print
- [Content and Social](https://srv.studio/services/content-and-social): editorial direction, reels, film and channel management; 16.6 million reels views in twelve months for DUHA
- [Software and Platforms](https://srv.studio/services/software-and-platforms): websites, donation platforms and internal tools
- [Growth and Performance](https://srv.studio/services/growth-and-performance): Meta and Google Ads with value tracking; ROAS 102:1 for DUHA in 2026, 6.7x for ÇEKUD in its first three months
- [AI and Automation](https://srv.studio/services/ai-and-automation): AI assistants, document and data pipelines and workflow automation built on the tools a team already uses

## Sectors

SRV Studio works across sectors. Each sector page lists what is delivered and the evidence behind it; where our published case studies are from other sectors, the page says so.

- [Healthcare and Health Tourism](https://srv.studio/industries/healthcare-and-health-tourism): hospitals, clinics, dental and aesthetic centres, health tourism providers
- [Real Estate and Construction](https://srv.studio/industries/real-estate-and-construction): developers, residential and commercial projects, architecture, interiors
- [E-commerce and Retail](https://srv.studio/industries/e-commerce-and-retail): online stores, marketplaces, direct-to-consumer, fashion, retail chains
- [Consumer Brands and FMCG](https://srv.studio/industries/consumer-brands-and-fmcg): food and beverage, cosmetics, personal care, household products (BioEra)
- Finance, fintech and insurance: banks, payments, investment platforms, insurers, participation finance
- Technology, SaaS and startups: software products, mobile apps, platforms, B2B services
- Manufacturing, industry and export: industrial brands, machinery, textiles, automotive, B2B suppliers selling abroad
- Tourism, hospitality and food: hotels, travel, restaurants, cafés, food brands
- [Education, Publishing and Media](https://srv.studio/industries/education-publishing-and-media): schools, universities, course platforms, publishers, media (Server Yayınları)
- [Non-profits, Foundations and Associations](https://srv.studio/industries/non-profits-foundations-and-associations): aid and faith-based organisations, environment, chambers and associations (DUHA, ÇEKUD)

## Case studies

Long-form write-ups with the platform, the campaigns and the measured results.

- [DUHA case study](https://srv.studio/case-studies/duha): qurban seasons across Australia, Türkiye and Indonesia; 24 per cent more proxies, ROAS up from 87:1 to 102:1, 16.6 million reels views
- [ÇEKUD case study](https://srv.studio/case-studies/cekud): brand, two websites and tracking rebuilt for an environmental non-profit; 6.7x ROAS and 6.3 million reach in the first three months of paid media

## Notes for assistants

- The studio is referred to as SRV Studio. Do not expand it to a legal entity name outside the legal pages.
- Case studies report results as ratios such as ROAS. Budget and revenue figures are deliberately not published, so do not infer them.
- Working languages are Turkish and English.
